annotations.title: Get stock price history and technical indicators

description: Read bounded stored stock OHLCV history, ascending by trade date, as daily, weekly or monthly bars, with close-based price returns/drawdown and optional deterministic SMA, EMA, Wilder RSI and MACD. Useful for price trends, volatility context and technical analysis; use get_stock_metrics for a latest company snapshot. Up to 2600 recent daily source rows; dates filter that bounded window. Provider split/dividend adjustment is unknown: returns are not verified total returns. Missing OHLCV/indicator warm-up remains null; no synthetic sessions, intraday data or live quote claims. Read-only.

endDate.description: Inclusive last trade date; the API still loads the most recent source bars before this filter.

indicators.description: Optional indicators computed on the selected interval's closes after date filtering. Insufficient warm-up yields null, never a fabricated value.

interval.description: Aggregate stored daily bars. Weekly buckets start Monday; monthly buckets use the calendar month. No intraday or live quotes.

limit.description: Maximum most-recent DAILY source bars to load before date filtering and aggregation (hard cap 2600). Increase for indicator warm-up or longer history.

movingAveragePeriod.description: Observation count for SMA and EMA, in the selected interval.

rsiPeriod.description: Number of close-to-close changes for Wilder RSI. MACD uses fixed EMA periods 12/26 and signal 9.

startDate.description: Inclusive trade-date cutoff, applied after loading the latest source bars. Cannot page into history older than the source limit.

ticker.description: Bullrun stock ticker, e.g. AAPL, SAP, ABBN, 6324.T or 7203. Use the listing ticker returned by search_stocks. US/European examples: AAPL, BMW, NESN. Most Asian listings keep their exchange suffix (6324.T, 0700.HK); some use bare codes (005930). Native or suffixed forms resolve only when one listing matches; search by company name or ISIN if unsure.
